messages:
mei: opened a PR to patch the model-catalog entry for Nebula3b-edge. Need to add an "Edge compatibility quirks" subsection, a tiny bench note, and fix a broken link to the runtime matrix. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5189
oliver: thanks. Please call out the sequence-ceiling behavior on low-memory devices (kv-cache trims at 2048 tokens for nebula3b-quant). That tripped a customer last week.
yasmin: Also include an explicit recommendation: use family pins (nebula3b@stable) for rolling fixes, exact pins for reproducible benchmarks. Show both SDK snippets.
mei: good. Drafted the quirks section describing kv cache trim, slightly higher cold-start latency on quant variants, and that runtime 3.0 lacks the fused-attn kernel (mark as "partial").
oliver: can you add a tiny two-row bench table: p50 latency (seq512) and toks/s (batch=1) for fp16 vs quant on g4dn? I'll paste numbers.
yasmin: Found a stale link in the card to docs/runtime-matrix-old.md. Replace with docs/runtime/matrix.md and add a redirect entry.
mei: will update link and create redirect PR. Assigning follow-ups: oliver - bench CSV + numbers; yasmin - snippet + redirect PR; I'll update the card text and request review.
docs-bot: PR #5189 opened by mei: docs/model-catalog: nebula3b-edge card - add edge quirks + link fix (labels: docs, model-catalog)
oliver: bench numbers: g4dn fp16 (nebula3b): p50=92ms (seq512), toks/s=540; nebula3b-quant (runtime 3.2 + selector): p50=98ms, toks/s=500; quant on runtime 3.0 (no fused-attn): toks/s=420. CSV attached to PR.
yasmin: SDK snippets ready. Example: 
```
# exact pin
client.generate(model="nebula3b@2026-01-15", prompt="...")
# family pin (allow compatible variants)
client.generate(model="nebula3b@stable", prompt="...")
# unpinned
client.generate(model="nebula3b", prompt="...")
```
mei: thanks all. I'll add the bench table, snippets, and the redirect. Plan to merge after CI + one approval. ping me for urgent wording nits.
oliver: +1
yasmin: +1
mei: merging after CI then. thanks! :shipit:
